+func (s *source) convertLegacy(ctx context.Context, x *indexes, in *inputs, workers int, l limiter) (map[common.Hash]*accountPatch, statefile.Conversion, error) {
+	patches := make(map[common.Hash]*accountPatch)
+	var evidence statefile.Conversion
+	r := accountReader{s: s}
+	ovm, err := r.get(ovmHash)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, evidence, err
+	}
+	if bytes.Equal(ovm.CodeHash, types.EmptyCodeHash[:]) {
+		return nil, evidence, errors.New("OVM_ETH has no code")
+	}
+	if err := s.validateRetain(ctx, x, in, &r); err != nil {
+		return nil, evidence, err
+	}
+	metadata, err := s.metadataSlots(ctx, ovm.Root)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, evidence, err
+	}
+	supplyWord, err := s.storageValue(ovmHash, ovm.Root, common.HexToHash("0x02"))
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, evidence, err
+	}
+	supply := new(uint256.Int).SetBytes(supplyWord[:])
+	jobs, err := s.balanceJobs(ctx, x, ovm.Root, metadata, l)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, evidence, err
+	}
+	keys := sortedHashes(jobs)
+	if err := s.classifyBalances(ctx, x, in, jobs, keys, workers, l); err != nil {
+		return nil, evidence, err
+	}
+	total, migrated, remaining, self := new(uint256.Int), new(uint256.Int), new(uint256.Int), new(uint256.Int)
+	storage := make(map[common.Hash]common.Hash)
+	for _, h := range keys {
+		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+			return nil, evidence, err
+		}
+		j := jobs[h]
+		if _, overflow := total.AddOverflow(total, &j.value); overflow {
+			return nil, evidence, errors.New("balance sum overflows uint256")
+		}
+		if j.address == ovmAddress {
+			self.Set(&j.value)
+			remaining.Add(remaining, &j.value)
+			continue
+		}
+		if j.contract && j.retain {
+			remaining.Add(remaining, &j.value)
+			evidence.RetainedContracts++
+			continue
+		}
+		if j.contract {
+			evidence.ConvertedContracts++
+		} else {
+			evidence.EOAs++
+		}
+		migrated.Add(migrated, &j.value)
+		patches[h] = &accountPatch{Address: j.address, Balance: new(uint256.Int).Set(&j.value)}
+		storage[j.slot] = common.Hash{}
+	}
+	if in.audit == nil {
+		if !total.Eq(supply) {
+			return nil, evidence, fmt.Errorf("OVM totalSupply mismatch: balances %s supply %s", total, supply)
+		}
+	} else {
+		if err := in.audit.matchAccounting(s.head.BlockNumber, common.BytesToHash(ovm.CodeHash), uint64(len(jobs)), total, supply); err != nil {
+			return nil, evidence, err
+		}
+		evidence.AuditHeight = in.audit.Identity.To
+		evidence.AuditHash = in.audit.Identity.ToHash
+	}
+	if !new(uint256.Int).Add(migrated, remaining).Eq(total) {
+		return nil, evidence, errors.New("conversion conservation mismatch")
+	}
+	supplySlot := common.HexToHash("0x02")
+	storage[crypto.Keccak256Hash(supplySlot[:])] = common.Hash(remaining.Bytes32())
+	runtime := in.runtime
+	patches[ovmHash] = &accountPatch{Address: ovmAddress, Balance: remaining, Code: &runtime, Storage: storage}
+	evidence.OriginalSupply = supply.Dec()
+	evidence.BalanceSum = total.Dec()
+	evidence.MigratedNative = migrated.Dec()
+	evidence.RemainingSupply = remaining.Dec()
+	evidence.SelfBalance = self.Dec()
+	return patches, evidence, nil
+}

+	return &stateNode[V]{max: key, items: items}
+}
+func (n *stateNode[V]) refresh() {
+	if len(n.children) != 0 {
+		n.max = n.children[len(n.children)-1].max
+	} else if len(n.items) != 0 {
+		n.max = n.items[len(n.items)-1].key
+	}
+}
+func (t *stateTree[V]) grow(right *stateNode[V]) {
+	if right == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	children := make([]*stateNode[V], 2, stateFanout)
+	children[0], children[1] = t.root, right
+	t.root = &stateNode[V]{max: right.max, children: children}
+}
+
+// Append is the streaming bulk builder. Reject duplicates and disorder instead
+// of silently replacing validated source records. Existing full nodes stay full.
+func (t *stateTree[V]) Append(key common.Hash, value V) error {
+	if t.root == nil {
+		t.root = newStateLeaf(key, value)
+		t.count = 1
+		return nil
+	}
+	if bytes.Compare(t.root.max[:], key[:]) >= 0 {
+		return errors.New("unordered state tree append")
+	}
+	t.grow(t.root.append(key, value))
+	t.count++
+	return nil
+}
+func (n *stateNode[V]) append(key common.Hash, value V) *stateNode[V] {
+	if len(n.children) == 0 {
+		if len(n.items) == stateLeafSize {
+			return newStateLeaf(key, value)
+		}
+		n.reserveItem()
+		n.items = append(n.items, stateItem[V]{key, value})
+		n.max = key
+		return nil
+	}
+	right := n.children[len(n.children)-1].append(key, value)
+	n.refresh()
+	if right == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if len(n.children) == stateFanout {
+		children := make([]*stateNode[V], 1, stateFanout)
+		children[0] = right
+		return &stateNode[V]{max: right.max, children: children}
+	}
+	n.children = append(n.children, right)
+	n.max = right.max
+	return nil
+}
+func (t *stateTree[V]) Set(key common.Hash, value V) {
+	if t.root == nil {
+		t.root = newStateLeaf(key, value)
+		t.count = 1
+		return
+	}
+	right, added := t.root.set(key, value)
+	t.grow(right)
+	if added {
+		t.count++
+	}
+}
+func (n *stateNode[V]) set(key common.Hash, value V) (*stateNode[V], bool) {
+	if len(n.children) == 0 {
+		return n.setItem(key, value)
+	}
+	i := n.childIndex(key)
+	right, added := n.children[i].set(key, value)
+	if right != nil {
+		n.children = append(n.children, nil)
+		copy(n.children[i+2:], n.children[i+1:])
+		n.children[i+1] = right
+	}
+	n.refresh()
+	if len(n.children) <= stateFanout {
+		return nil, added
+	}
+	mid := len(n.children) / 2
+	children := make([]*stateNode[V], len(n.children)-mid, stateFanout)
+	copy(children, n.children[mid:])
+	clear(n.children[mid:])
+	n.children = n.children[:mid]
+	n.refresh()
+	return &stateNode[V]{max: children[len(children)-1].max, children: children}, added
+}
+func (n *stateNode[V]) setItem(key common.Hash, value V) (*stateNode[V], bool) {
+	i := n.itemIndex(key)
+	if i < len(n.items) && n.items[i].key == key {
+		n.items[i].value = value
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	if len(n.items) == stateLeafSize {
+		mid := len(n.items) / 2
+		items := make([]stateItem[V], len(n.items)-mid, stateLeafSize)
+		copy(items, n.items[mid:])
+		clear(n.items[mid:])
+		n.items = n.items[:mid]
+		n.refresh()
+		right := &stateNode[V]{max: items[len(items)-1].key, items: items}
+		if bytes.Compare(key[:], n.max[:]) <= 0 {
+			n.insertItem(i, key, value)
+		} else {
+			right.insertItem(i-mid, key, value)
+		}
+		return right, true
+	}
+	n.insertItem(i, key, value)
+	return nil, true
+}
+
+// Explicit capacities avoid allocator size-class rounding retaining more than
+// one leaf's entries, while tiny per-account storage starts with one entry.
+func (n *stateNode[V]) reserveItem() {
+	if len(n.items) < cap(n.items) {
+		return
+	}
+	items := make([]stateItem[V], len(n.items), min(stateLeafSize, max(1, 2*cap(n.items))))
+	copy(items, n.items)
+	n.items = items
+}
+func (n *stateNode[V]) insertItem(i int, key common.Hash, value V) {
+	n.reserveItem()
+	n.items = append(n.items, stateItem[V]{})
+	copy(n.items[i+1:], n.items[i:])
+	n.items[i] = stateItem[V]{key, value}
+	n.refresh()
+}
+func (t *stateTree[V]) Delete(key common.Hash) {
+	if t.root == nil || !t.root.remove(key) {
+		return
+	}
+	t.count--
+	if t.count == 0 {
+		t.root = nil
+		return
+	}
+	for len(t.root.children) == 1 {
+		t.root = t.root.children[0]
+	}
+}
+func (n *stateNode[V]) remove(key common.Hash) bool {
+	if len(n.children) == 0 {
+		i := n.itemIndex(key)
+		if i == len(n.items) || n.items[i].key != key {
+			return false
+		}
+		copy(n.items[i:], n.items[i+1:])
+		clear(n.items[len(n.items)-1:])
+		n.items = n.items[:len(n.items)-1]
+		n.refresh()
+		return true
+	}
+	i := n.childIndex(key)
+	child := n.children[i]
+	if !child.remove(key) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if len(child.items) == 0 && len(child.children) == 0 {
+		copy(n.children[i:], n.children[i+1:])
+		n.children[len(n.children)-1] = nil
+		n.children = n.children[:len(n.children)-1]
+	}
+	n.refresh()
+	return true
+}
+func (t *stateTree[V]) Visit(visit func(common.Hash, V) error) error { return t.root.visit(visit) }
+func (n *stateNode[V]) visit(visit func(common.Hash, V) error) error {
+	if n == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, child := range n.children {
+		if err := child.visit(visit); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	for _, item := range n.items {
+		if err := visit(item.key, item.value); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// Drain transfers exclusive ownership to a one-shot traversal. Each leaf is
+// released only after its entries and the acknowledgement callback succeed.
+// A failure drops all remaining state: consumed output cannot be retried. No
+// freelist, clone, iterator, or historical root retains consumed nodes.
+func (t *stateTree[V]) Drain(visit func(common.Hash, V) error, ack func() error) error {
+	root := t.root
+	t.root = nil
+	t.count = 0
+	return root.drain(visit, ack)
+}
+func (n *stateNode[V]) drain(visit func(common.Hash, V) error, ack func() error) error {
+	if n == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if len(n.children) != 0 {
+		for i := range n.children {
+			child := n.children[i]
+			n.children[i] = nil
+			if err := child.drain(visit, ack); err != nil {
+				clear(n.children)
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		n.children = nil
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, item := range n.items {
+		if err := visit(item.key, item.value); err != nil {
+			clear(n.items)
+			n.items = nil
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	if ack != nil {
+		if err := ack(); err != nil {
+			clear(n.items)
+			n.items = nil
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	clear(n.items)
+	n.items = nil
+	return nil
+}

+package migration

+func treeKey(n int) common.Hash {

+
+func checkStateTree[V any](t *testing.T, tree *stateTree[V]) {
+	t.Helper()
+	depth := -1
+	count := 0
+	var check func(*stateNode[V], int)
+	check = func(n *stateNode[V], level int) {
+		if n == nil {
+			t.Fatal("nil child")
+		}
+		if len(n.children) == 0 {
+			if len(n.items) == 0 || len(n.items) > stateLeafSize || cap(n.items) > stateLeafSize {
+				t.Fatal("invalid leaf capacity")
+			}
+			if depth < 0 {
+				depth = level
+			}
+			if depth != level {
+				t.Fatal("unbalanced leaf depth")
+			}
+			if n.max != n.items[len(n.items)-1].key {
+				t.Fatal("leaf upper bound")
+			}
+			for i, item := range n.items {
+				if i > 0 && bytes.Compare(n.items[i-1].key[:], item.key[:]) >= 0 {
+					t.Fatal("unordered leaf")
+				}
+			}
+			count += len(n.items)
+			return
+		}
+		if len(n.children) > stateFanout || len(n.items) != 0 {
+			t.Fatal("invalid branch")
+		}

+			if i > 0 && bytes.Compare(n.children[i-1].max[:], c.max[:]) >= 0 {
+				t.Fatal("unordered branch")
+			}
+			check(c, level+1)
+		}
+		if n.max != n.children[len(n.children)-1].max {
+			t.Fatal("branch upper bound")
+		}
+	}
+	if tree.root != nil {
+		check(tree.root, 0)
+	}
+	if count != tree.Len() {
+		t.Fatalf("length %d != %d", count, tree.Len())
+	}
+}

+		}

+		}
+	}
